		// Configuration for different pricing redirects
		const pricingConfig = [
			{
				cookieName: 'free-pricing',
				urlPatterns: ['powered-by', 'pricing-free'],
				targetPath: '/pricing-free'
			},
			{
				cookieName: 'welcome-pricing',
				urlPatterns: ['welcome', 'pricing-welcome'],
				targetPath: '/pricing-welcome'
			}
		];

		// Function to check URL and set cookie if needed
		function checkURLAndSetCookie() {
			const currentUrl = window.location.href;

			for ( const config of pricingConfig ) {
				if ( config.urlPatterns.some( pattern => currentUrl.includes( pattern ) ) ) {
					document.cookie = `${config.cookieName}=true; path=/; max-age=${30 * 24 * 60 * 60}`;
					return config;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		// Function to check if any pricing cookie exists
		function getActivePricingConfig() {
			const cookies = document.cookie.split( ';' );

			for ( const config of pricingConfig ) {
				if ( cookies.some( item => item.trim().startsWith( `${config.cookieName}=` ) ) ) {
					return config;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		// Function to update all pricing links
		function updatePricingLinks( config ) {
			const links = document.getElementsByTagName( 'a' );

			Array.from( links ).forEach( link => {
				// Only change links that contain /pricing but not already a custom pricing path
				if ( link.href.includes( '/pricing' ) &&
				     !link.href.includes( '/pricing-free' ) &&
				     !link.href.includes( '/pricing-welcome' ) ) {
					link.href = link.href.replace( '/pricing', config.targetPath );
				}
			} );
		}

		// Main execution
		function init() {
			// Check if we need to set cookie based on URL
			let activeConfig = checkURLAndSetCookie();

			// If no cookie was just set, check for existing cookie
			if ( !activeConfig ) {
				activeConfig = getActivePricingConfig();
			}

			// If we have an active config, update the links
			if ( activeConfig ) {
				updatePricingLinks( activeConfig );
			}
		}

		// Run when DOM is fully loaded
		document.addEventListener( 'DOMContentLoaded', init );
	</script>

			function getCookie(name) {
				var nameEQ = name + '=';
				var ca = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie).split(';');
				for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
					var c = ca[i].trim();
					if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) === 0) return c.substring(nameEQ.length);
				}
				return '';
			}

			var affiliateProducts = {

			};

			function replacePlaceholders(campaignEl) {
				var code = getCookie('wpconsent_affiliate_code');
				var productName = affiliateProducts[code.toUpperCase()] || 'Lite';

				if (productName && campaignEl) {
					var walker = document.createTreeWalker(campaignEl, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);

					while (walker.nextNode()) {
						var node = walker.currentNode;
						if (node.nodeValue.indexOf('[product_name]') > -1 ||
							node.nodeValue.indexOf('[affiliate_code]') > -1) {
							node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue
								.replace(/\\[product_name\\]/g, productName)
								.replace(/\\[affiliate_code\\]/g, code);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			document.addEventListener('om.Campaign.afterShow', function(event) {
				var campaign = event.detail.Campaign;
				var campaignEl = campaign.contain;
				replacePlaceholders(campaignEl);
			});
		})();

	<script>
		// Configuration for different pricing redirects
		const pricingConfig = [
			{
				cookieName: 'free-pricing',
				urlPatterns: ['powered-by', 'pricing-free'],
				targetPath: '/pricing-free'
			},
			{
				cookieName: 'welcome-pricing',
				urlPatterns: ['welcome', 'pricing-welcome'],
				targetPath: '/pricing-welcome'
			}
		];

		// Function to check URL and set cookie if needed
		function checkURLAndSetCookie() {
			const currentUrl = window.location.href;

			for ( const config of pricingConfig ) {
				if ( config.urlPatterns.some( pattern => currentUrl.includes( pattern ) ) ) {
					document.cookie = `${config.cookieName}=true; path=/; max-age=${30 * 24 * 60 * 60}`;
					return config;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		// Function to check if any pricing cookie exists
		function getActivePricingConfig() {
			const cookies = document.cookie.split( ';' );

			for ( const config of pricingConfig ) {
				if ( cookies.some( item => item.trim().startsWith( `${config.cookieName}=` ) ) ) {
					return config;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		// Function to update all pricing links
		function updatePricingLinks( config ) {
			const links = document.getElementsByTagName( 'a' );

			Array.from( links ).forEach( link => {
				// Only change links that contain /pricing but not already a custom pricing path
				if ( link.href.includes( '/pricing' ) &&
				     !link.href.includes( '/pricing-free' ) &&
				     !link.href.includes( '/pricing-welcome' ) ) {
					link.href = link.href.replace( '/pricing', config.targetPath );
				}
			} );
		}

		// Main execution
		function init() {
			// Check if we need to set cookie based on URL
			let activeConfig = checkURLAndSetCookie();

			// If no cookie was just set, check for existing cookie
			if ( !activeConfig ) {
				activeConfig = getActivePricingConfig();
			}

			// If we have an active config, update the links
			if ( activeConfig ) {
				updatePricingLinks( activeConfig );
			}
		}

		// Run when DOM is fully loaded
		document.addEventListener( 'DOMContentLoaded', init );
	</script>

		<script>
		(function() {
			function getCookie(name) {
				var nameEQ = name + '=';
				var ca = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie).split(';');
				for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
					var c = ca[i].trim();
					if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) === 0) return c.substring(nameEQ.length);
				}
				return '';
			}

			var affiliateProducts = {
				AFFWP60: 'AffiliateWP',
				OPTINMONSTER60: 'OptinMonster',
				TRUSTPULSE60: 'TrustPulse',
				THRIVE60: 'Thrive Themes',
				AIOSEO60: 'AIOSEO',
				SEARCHWP60: 'SearchWP',
				EDD2660: 'Easy Digital Downloads',
				WPSIMPLEPAY60: 'WP Simple Pay',
				WPCHARITABLE60: 'Charitable',
				SUGARCALENDAR60: 'Sugar Calendar',
				WPFORMS60: 'WPForms',
				WPMAILSMTP60: 'WP Mail SMTP',
				EASYWPSMTP60: 'Easy WP SMTP',
				ATHEMES60: 'aThemes',
				SEEDPROD60: 'SeedProd',
				RAFFLEPRESS60: 'RafflePress',
				DUPLICATOR60: 'Duplicator',
				WPCODE60: 'WPCode',
				PUSHENGAGE60: 'PushEngage',
				WPB60: 'WPBeginner',

				EXACTMETRICS60: 'ExactMetrics',
				SMASHBALLOON60: 'Smash Balloon',
				WPBWORKSHOP: 'WPBeginner'
			};

			function replacePlaceholders(campaignEl) {
				var code = getCookie('wpconsent_affiliate_code');
				var productName = affiliateProducts[code.toUpperCase()] || 'Lite';

				if (productName && campaignEl) {
					var walker = document.createTreeWalker(campaignEl, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);

					while (walker.nextNode()) {
						var node = walker.currentNode;
						if (node.nodeValue.indexOf('[product_name]') > -1 ||
							node.nodeValue.indexOf('[affiliate_code]') > -1) {
							node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue
								.replace(/\\[product_name\\]/g, productName)
								.replace(/\\[affiliate_code\\]/g, code);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			document.addEventListener('om.Campaign.afterShow', function(event) {
				var campaign = event.detail.Campaign;
				var campaignEl = campaign.contain;
				replacePlaceholders(campaignEl);
			});
		})();

	<script>
		// Configuration for different pricing redirects
		const pricingConfig = [
			{
				cookieName: 'free-pricing',
				urlPatterns: ['powered-by', 'pricing-free'],
				targetPath: '/pricing-free'
			},
			{
				cookieName: 'welcome-pricing',
				urlPatterns: ['welcome', 'pricing-welcome'],
				targetPath: '/pricing-welcome'
			}
		];

		// Function to check URL and set cookie if needed
		function checkURLAndSetCookie() {
			const currentUrl = window.location.href;

			for ( const config of pricingConfig ) {
				if ( config.urlPatterns.some( pattern => currentUrl.includes( pattern ) ) ) {
					document.cookie = `${config.cookieName}=true; path=/; max-age=${30 * 24 * 60 * 60}`;
					return config;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		// Function to check if any pricing cookie exists
		function getActivePricingConfig() {
			const cookies = document.cookie.split( ';' );

			for ( const config of pricingConfig ) {
				if ( cookies.some( item => item.trim().startsWith( `${config.cookieName}=` ) ) ) {
					return config;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		// Function to update all pricing links
		function updatePricingLinks( config ) {
			const links = document.getElementsByTagName( 'a' );

			Array.from( links ).forEach( link => {
				// Only change links that contain /pricing but not already a custom pricing path
				if ( link.href.includes( '/pricing' ) &&
				     !link.href.includes( '/pricing-free' ) &&
				     !link.href.includes( '/pricing-welcome' ) ) {
					link.href = link.href.replace( '/pricing', config.targetPath );
				}
			} );
		}

		// Main execution
		function init() {
			// Check if we need to set cookie based on URL
			let activeConfig = checkURLAndSetCookie();

			// If no cookie was just set, check for existing cookie
			if ( !activeConfig ) {
				activeConfig = getActivePricingConfig();
			}

			// If we have an active config, update the links
			if ( activeConfig ) {
				updatePricingLinks( activeConfig );
			}
		}

		// Run when DOM is fully loaded
		document.addEventListener( 'DOMContentLoaded', init );
	</script>

		(function() {
			function getCookie(name) {
				var nameEQ = name + '=';
				var ca = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie).split(';');
				for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
					var c = ca[i].trim();

			function replacePlaceholders(campaignEl) {
				var code = getCookie('wpconsent_affiliate_code');
				var productName = affiliateProducts[code.toUpperCase()] || 'Lite';

				if (productName && campaignEl) {
					var walker = document.createTreeWalker(campaignEl, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);

					while (walker.nextNode()) {
						var node = walker.currentNode;
						if (node.nodeValue.indexOf('[product_name]') > -1 ||
							node.nodeValue.indexOf('[affiliate_code]') > -1) {
							node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue
								.replace(/\\[product_name\\]/g, productName)
								.replace(/\\[affiliate_code\\]/g, code);
						}
					}
				}
			}

	<script>
		// Configuration for different pricing redirects
		const pricingConfig = [
			{
				cookieName: 'free-pricing',
				urlPatterns: ['powered-by', 'pricing-free'],
				targetPath: '/pricing-free'
			},
			{
				cookieName: 'welcome-pricing',
				urlPatterns: ['welcome', 'pricing-welcome'],
				targetPath: '/pricing-welcome'
			}
		];

		// Function to check URL and set cookie if needed
		function checkURLAndSetCookie() {
			const currentUrl = window.location.href;

			for ( const config of pricingConfig ) {
				if ( config.urlPatterns.some( pattern => currentUrl.includes( pattern ) ) ) {
					document.cookie = `${config.cookieName}=true; path=/; max-age=${30 * 24 * 60 * 60}`;
					return config;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		// Function to check if any pricing cookie exists
		function getActivePricingConfig() {
			const cookies = document.cookie.split( ';' );

			for ( const config of pricingConfig ) {
				if ( cookies.some( item => item.trim().startsWith( `${config.cookieName}=` ) ) ) {
					return config;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		// Function to update all pricing links
		function updatePricingLinks( config ) {
			const links = document.getElementsByTagName( 'a' );

			Array.from( links ).forEach( link => {
				// Only change links that contain /pricing but not already a custom pricing path
				if ( link.href.includes( '/pricing' ) &&
				     !link.href.includes( '/pricing-free' ) &&
				     !link.href.includes( '/pricing-welcome' ) ) {
					link.href = link.href.replace( '/pricing', config.targetPath );
				}
			} );
		}

		// Main execution
		function init() {
			// Check if we need to set cookie based on URL
			let activeConfig = checkURLAndSetCookie();

			// If no cookie was just set, check for existing cookie
			if ( !activeConfig ) {
				activeConfig = getActivePricingConfig();
			}

			// If we have an active config, update the links
			if ( activeConfig ) {
				updatePricingLinks( activeConfig );
			}
		}

		// Run when DOM is fully loaded
		document.addEventListener( 'DOMContentLoaded', init );
	</script>

			function getCookie(name) {
				var nameEQ = name + '=';
				var ca = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie).split(';');
				for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
					var c = ca[i].trim();

			};

			function replacePlaceholders(campaignEl) {
				var code = getCookie('wpconsent_affiliate_code');
				var productName = affiliateProducts[code.toUpperCase()] || 'Lite';

				if (productName && campaignEl) {
					var walker = document.createTreeWalker(campaignEl, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);

					while (walker.nextNode()) {
						var node = walker.currentNode;
						if (node.nodeValue.indexOf('[product_name]') > -1 ||
							node.nodeValue.indexOf('[affiliate_code]') > -1) {
							node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue
								.replace(/\\[product_name\\]/g, productName)
								.replace(/\\[affiliate_code\\]/g, code);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			document.addEventListener('om.Campaign.afterShow', function(event) {
				var campaign = event.detail.Campaign;
				var campaignEl = campaign.contain;
				replacePlaceholders(campaignEl);
			});
		})();
